tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dus las: bsnyen dbang zab mo bzhugs so:

rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bsnyen pa'i snod du bya ba'i phyir: rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa ni: dang po skyon med snod brtags la: phyag 'tshal maṇ+ḍal sngon song nas: skyabs 'gro gsol btab lhar bskyed cing: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang sbyin: mtha' rten sku dang bzlas lung dang: phur bskor phrin las ma lus sdud: khas blangs dga' ston shis pa brjod: bya ba'i rim pa kun bsdus pa'o: zhes pas mdun bskyed kyi sgrub rdzas rnams legs par bshams la: slob dpon gyis bsnyen cing bsgrubs te: bdag 'jug blangs te: slob ma khrus nas dbyung zhing: oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha wā ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐: gis mig dar bcings shing: ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐: gis me tog bkram la maṇ+ḍa la phul te: slob bus snyim pa me tog dang bcas te: gsol ba gdab pa ni: dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste: slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol: byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa: mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo: dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol: byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol: thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu: mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol: zhes pas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang: sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: bdag gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir: byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas: sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer: byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: ces dang: thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs sems ni: na mo: skye med don gyi bla ma sku gsum la:

'gag med rang rtsal ye nas rang gsal gdab: zhen med blo 'das rang rig lhun grub kyang: 'dzin med sku gsum rang chas skyabs su mchi: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la: yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid kyis: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed: slob ma bsang zhing sbyangs la lhar bskyed pa ni: gnas gzhi dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po: nyin par rlung dmar 'tshubs shing du ba phyur pa: mtshan me 'bar ba: gnod sbyin dang: sha za dang: 'byung po dang: ma rungs pa'i tshogs du ma rgyu ba: bya rog dang: bya rgod dang: bzhad la sogs pa'i bya sha zan mang po nam mkha' la lding ba: keng rus sha med cing rus pa 'cha' ba: dus ma yin par ser ba drag po dang: gnam lcags kyi thog 'bab pa: rdo thams cad tshag sgra 'don pa: shing thams cad hūm̐ 'dren pa: chu thams cad rgyob sod dang: sa gzhi thams cad chem chem dang: mā ra ya'i sgra 'brug ltar ldir zhing: nad kyi na bun chen pos thams cad 'thibs pa: skyi g.ya' 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod chen po de'i dbus su: sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros: dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim: de yongs su gyur pa las: skad cig gis dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas rdo rje'i be con nam mkha' la phyar zhing: g.yon pas gnam lcags kyi tho ba ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba bsnams nas: gdug pa can thams cad klad nas gzir bar byed pa: dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing: zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa: dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa'i spyi gtsug nas rta mgo ljang zhur drag tu 'tsher ba: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs kyis sbyor ging bsnol ba'i steng na bzhugs pa:

khro tshul gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing: dur khrod kyi chas chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: thugs ka'i dbus su sngags sa bon dang bcas pas mtshan par dmigs la: bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las: 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul la: gnas yul dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs na gnas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprin gyi phung po lta bus bskor ba spyan drangs: slob ma la thim par bsam zhing: hrī: dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: thugs rgyud ngar dang bcas nas su: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: sa pa ri bā ra ā be sha ya a ā: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: zhes pa'i mjug tu rtsa sngags kyis byin dbab cing: ā be sha ya a: a dhi tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ gyis brtan par bzhugs nas: rtsa sngags kyis dpung skud bcings shing dri chus byin gyis brlabs shing rdo rje rgya gram gyi rgya dang: las sngags kyis brtan par byed cing: rdzas dbang dur khrod chas brgyad bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku stod la: glang chen rlon pa'i rgyan gsol bas: gti mug 'joms pa'i stobs ldan pas: shes rab mchog ldan dbang thob shog: glang chen ko rlon stod la g.yogs: hrī: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku regs la: mi lpags g.yang gzhi 'di gsol bas: 'khor bar mi ldog nus stobs ldan: rtogs grol ldan pa'i dbang thob shog: zhing chen g.yang gzhi rked la dkri ba'i tshul bya: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku smad la: stag gi sham thabs 'di gsol bas: 'khor ba sgrol ba'i nus stobs ldan: mtha' gnyis 'joms pa'i dbang thob shog: stag sham smad la dkri ba'i tshul bya:

hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku rgyan la: thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa yis: chos sku mthar phyin stobs ldan nas: rnam rtog 'joms pa'i dbang thob shog: mi mgo'i do zhal se ral khar brgyan pa'i tshul bya: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku mchog la: gdug pa sbrul gyis rab brgyan pas: zhe sdang rnam dag mthu stobs ldan: dug lnga 'joms pa'i dbang thob shog: sbrul gyi chun pos yan lag la brgyan pa'i tshul bya: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku mchog la: zhag gi zo ris brgyan pa la: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan: ye shes smin pa'i dbang thob shog: zhag gi zo ris kyis sku dang zhal gyi khyim la brgyan pa'i tshul bya: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku mchog la: thal chen tshom bus rab brgyan pas: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa dang: bdud bzhi dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i dbang thob shog: thal chen gyi tshom bus sku la byug pa'i tshul bya: hūm̐: rgyal sras khyod kyi sku mchog la: khrag gi thig les rab brgyan pas: 'gro ba thugs rjes 'dren pa'i stobs dang ldan: ma chags 'gro don byed pa'i dbang thob shog: rak+ta'i thig le mkhur tshos dang dpral bar brgyan pa'i tshul bya: de ltar dur khrod chas brgyad kyi dbang bskur pas: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i skur gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan par byas la: rdo rje gser thur gyis mig dar phyes la: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces mig dar phyes la rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byed pa'o: lha la slob ma gtod pa me tog phreng ba'i dbang ni: slob bus me tog sngon po dkyil 'khor la gtor zhing: sangs rgyas dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni: 'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis: sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol: pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho: zhes brjod: slar yang bla mas dngos grub kyi tshul du me tog gi phreng ba slob bu la sbyin pa ni:

pra tī gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la: sems dpa' stobs po che khyed rang gis slob ma 'di snying po byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du rjes su zungs shig: ces dang me tog spyi bor bzhag go: de nas dbang dngos la 'jug pa'i don du slob bus gsol ba btab pa ni: snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do: dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin: rdo rje mi phyed sku bsgoms pas: sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni: byin rlabs gnas su de ltar mdzod: dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin: rdo rje mi phyed gsung bsgoms pas: gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni: byin rlabs gnas su de ltar mdzod: dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin: rdo rje mi phyed thugs bsgoms pas: thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni: byin rlabs gnas su de ltar mdzod: ces gsol ba btab pas: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs pa mdzad: yum lngas dbang bskur: khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad de: mngon par dbang bskur bar mos la: bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste: ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni: lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar: lha yi chu ni dag pa yis: de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: bum pa'i chu sbyin zhing dbang bskur pas lus gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing: bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas: thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun bdag po ye shes mchog: sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste: bkra shis des ni dbang bskur mchog de khyod la shog: ces shis pa brjod cing me tog gtor: slar yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas: dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi sku mchog dpag tu med pa byon:

slob ma'i lus la thim pas dbyer med du bsam zhing: gtor ma tsaka li dang bcas pa slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag ste: hūm̐: dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku yi dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: rta mgrin sku ni rab bsgrub phyir: sku yi dbang ni khyod la bskur: oṃ ma hā kro ta hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ: zhes dbang chen sku yi dbang bskur pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag: rta mgrin sku'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang: sku yi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung zhing: 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so: slar yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mgrin pa nas: gsung yig 'bru'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon: slob ma'i ngag la thim par bsam zhing: bgrang phreng mgrin par bskur te: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin gsung gi dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: rta mgrin gsung ni rab bsgrub phyir: gsung gi dbang 'di khyod la bskur: zhes dang: rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ.āḥ.ā: zhes dbang chen gsung gi dbang bskur pas: ngag gi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang: gsung gi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung zhing 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so: slar yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas: thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byon: slob ma'i snying khar thim par bsam ste: phur bu snying gar bskur te: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin thugs kyi dbang: de ring khyod la bskur bar bya: dbang chen thugs ni rab bsgrub phyir: thugs kyi dbang ni khyod la bskur: zhes dang: rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

zhes dbang chen thugs kyi dbang bskur pas: yid kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag: dbang chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang: thugs kyi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung zhing: 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so: mthar rten dgra gdon gyi rū pa la gdon bgegs thams cad bkug par dmigs te: nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥdza: zhes bkug nas phur bskor dang bcas pas snying dbus su gdab cing: hūm̐: dbang chen khros pa kī la ya: lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: dam nyams bgegs la smros ci dgos: badz+ra thun bh+yo: sogs kyis gzir: hūm̐ gis 'dren cing phaṭa kyis spar nas: slob ma bgegs dang bral bar byas nas: bzlas lung sbyin pa ni: slar yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa'i tshul du byung: slob ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs: snying gar sa bon la sngags phreng gis g.yas skor du 'khor bar dmigs te: oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hūm̐ḥhūm̐ḥhūm̐: phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭa: badz+ra thun bh+yo: badz+ra trig nan: badz+ra dzaḥdza: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: haṃ shaṃ tri trig nan: tri hur thuṃ dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: oṃ tu trig trig: tu trig trig: tri hur thuṃ dza: mā ya ra phaṭa: sarba bhū ta trig nan: zhes tshar gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug: slob bus: bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis: bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol: slob dpon gyis: bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis: 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol: sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol: dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnam pa bzhi rdo rje slob ma 'di'i thugs rgyud la 'jug par mdzad du gsol:

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā: zhes dang: sku gsung thugs kyi shis brjod kyang bya'o: de ltar dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bzung zhing khas blang ba ni: slob bus gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: zhes dang: lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa: bla ma dang dbang chen gyi lha tshogs la gtang rag gi tshul du 'bul ba ni: slob bus deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang: cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol: zhes so: slob dpon gyis lha la mchod cing bstod de: nongs pa bshags pa bya ba dang: 'od zer spro bsdu'i dbang blangs nas: rten yod na rang bzhin la bzhugs su gsol zhing: med na ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs par mos la: dam tshig pa rang la bsdu: bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis byin chags par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: maṅga laṃ// //
